newsitem.title: USA: Angeion says focuses on St. Jude separation.
newsitem.headline: Angeion says focuses on St. Jude separation.

text.p: Angeion Corp said on Monday that it is focusing nearterm on its "disengagement" from St. Jude Medical Inc as its distribution partner.

"The separation from St. Jude Medical as our distribution partner is our near-term focus," said Whitney McFarlin, Angeion Corp chairman, president and chief executive officer, in a letter to shareholders.

He said that on November 20, Angeion sent St. Jude a formal notice of rescission and termination of the original equipment manufacturing and patent cross licensing agreements and that St. Jude responded by requesting a judicial declaration on the validity of the agreements.
"We are pursuing the process of disengagement with St. Jude, and this is just one step in that direction," he added.
A St. Jude spokesman was unavailable for immediate comment.
Angeion Corp shares slumped in late November after an arbitration decision that awarded Medtronic Inc access to a specific group of Angeion defibrillator product patents.
McFarlin, in his letter, linked part of the firm's stock drop to "misinformation purveyed by a few industry analysts" concerning the impact of the Medtronic decision.
Angeion shares closed unchanged on Monday at 3-1/8.
